notes.title: Full Release
notes.content:
Titans,

We’re thrilled to announce that Astraea is officially out of early access and has now reached full release after two years of dedicated development. This has been a true labor of love for us, and we couldn’t be more excited to share it with you!

[b]Level Updates[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030892/01ed3756e89462a7c653254dfe893738710a0fe5.png[/img]

From the start, our goal was to make Astraea feel like a disaster movie brought to life, with you right in the thick of it. We’ve now completed the final touches to achieve this vision. The storm rages on, toppling trees, breaking fences, and scattering pillars, while animals frantically dart across the screen. The chaos is here, and we hope you enjoy every moment of it!

[b]Endless Mode[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030892/dd544bf8c5e62c60f2acb9a8259b766c8bfd74ec.png[/img]

In our last update, we introduced the foundation of Endless Mode. Since then, we’ve made significant improvements to make it even more engaging. This includes:

* New dialogue and voice lines to keep the experience fresh.
* Unique one-time events to surprise you.
* Expanded looping events for sustained variety

[b]Rebalancing and Fixes[/b]

We’ve fine-tuned the game further by adjusting enemy health and trap damage, aiming for a balanced and fair experience for all players. Additionally, we’ve fixed issues that affected our Korean players, including missing text, ensuring a smooth experience for everyone.

Thank you for joining us on this journey. We’re incredibly proud of what we’ve built and deeply grateful for your support. See you in the chaos!

Vizabee Games

notes.title: 1.9.0 Released
notes.content:
Hello Titans,

Endless Mode has finally arrived as well as an improved first night! We hope to flush this out more based on your feedback.

* Added Endless Mode and statistic to track your personal best record
* Added new music for Endless Mode
* Added ability to toggle auto-traps during gameplay from feedback
* Added auto-trap indicator on interface
* Added two stage events to the first night
* Updated background on the first night
* Updated objects on the first night
* Updated localization files
* Rebalanced enemies for late game

Thanks,
Vizabee Games

notes.title: 1.6.0 Released
notes.content:
Hello Titans,

Zeus decided to add more blessings, and change where and when they are dropped. The purpose is to always provide you with one bolt, one trap, and one utility blessing per drop, as well as give you certain blessings based on conditions. Everything has been reorganized and set to get you something good each time.

[list]
[*] Added a system to drop certain blessings based on game conditions, such as being damaged.
[*] Added a system to drop certain blessings at different times of the night
[*] Added Faster Cooldown blessing for bolts
[*] Added Faster Cooldown blessing for traps
[*] Updated Faster Respawn to spawn in the utilities column
[*] Updated Faster Respawn to be a possible drop once you took damage
[*] Updated Better Luck to be a possible drop on the first drop of the night
[*] Updated More Accuracy to spawn in the utilities column
[*] Updated More Accuracy to be a possible drop on the second drop of the night
[*] Updated More Luck to be a possible drop on the first drop of the night
[*] Fixed missing line break in some localized credits.
[*] Fixed missing names in the some localized credits.
[/list]

We hope you love the new cooldown blessings. There is nothing more satisfying that setting out all your traps in less than a second.

Thanks,
Vizabee Games

notes.title: 1.3.0 Released
notes.content:
Hello Titans,

This update adds new events, backgrounds, improved systems, and more.

[b]Full List[/b]
[list]
[*]Added an event where a dagger is thrown at the player
[*]Added an event where a sandstorm occurs
[*]Added an event where the spiderweb lowers as the cave's rock ceiling falls
[*]Added new background and spider web graphics on the third stage
[*]Added the bunny to the cutscenes where a battle is won or lost
[*]Added an animation for when Hell Mode is picked from the menu
[*]Updated the helmet kicking system to make it easier to kill elements with fallen helmets
[*]Updated the appearance of the helmets to make them more noticeable on the ground
[*]Updated the sound effects for falling rocks to use our crackle sound
[*]Updated the worm's starting position so they are more noticeable when freed
[*]Updated droppable object system so dropped objects can spawn on any layer (future)
[*]Increased Stryge's health from 1 to 8
[*]Increased Ladon's health from 1 to 10
[*]Fixed issue with helmets were not dealing damage
[*]Fixed issue with helmets piercing through enemies
[/list]
Thanks,
Vizabee Games
